comida.titulo: Food and drink themes to play Draft 20
intro: Food is the most played category in Draft 20, and it's no coincidence: everyone has a strong opinion about a burger, an omelette, or a tray of sushi. Here the challenge is not about who knows more, but about who bids best for what they want.
Themes range from the usual bar to pizza, including tacos, the air fryer, Sunday BBQ, Viral Desserts or craft beer. Great for playing before dinner or discussing what goes into a perfect burger.
comida.truco: In food it is played at two speeds: the artisan dishes and ingredients are really fought over and the crappy ones serve to inflate. Don't spend your bankroll on what everyone recognizes as good; save it for the item that completes your team and let the rival pay more for their whim.

cultura.titulo: Film, series and music themes for Draft 20
intro: Few discussions are as fun as those about popular culture: overrated movies, killer series, embarrassing albums and cursed musicals. This category turns those talks into an 8-round auction.
Themes with modern classics and also with glorious disasters, because part of the beauty of Draft 20 is that you have to bid on an item that you would not want even as a gift.
cultura.truco: Culture punishes the fan: if the rival loves a saga, he will pay a lot for his icons and you must let him, going up one at a time before dropping out. Your coins go to the transversal classics that everyone respects but no one idolizes: they are cheaper and score equally well.

viral.titulo: Viral themes: characters and sagas for Draft 20
intro: The most shared category on WhatsApp: sagas and characters that everyone instantly recognizes. It doesn't matter if you've seen all the movies or none: if you know who Darth Vader or Pikachu is, you can start bidding.
Themes that mix nostalgia, internet culture and fandoms (from K-pop to La Velada), with legendary items and the occasional character that no one wants to touch.
viral.truco: Since everyone recognizes each character, the prices inflate themselves: patience wins here. Let the rival take their favorite by paying more in the first rounds and close yourself with beloved secondaries at half the price. Other people's nostalgia is your best ally to inflate.

deporte.titulo: Sports and motor themes to play Draft 20
intro: From soccer to Formula 1: the category for those who discuss lineups and compare eras. Each theme has its untouchable legends and its signings that went wrong, and that's the sauce of the auction.
Themes with team sports, individual sports, paddle tennis, World Cup, eSports and motor sports. Perfect for playing with an opponent who knows all the records... or who pretends to know them.
deporte.truco: In sports, legends are very expensive because no one wants to be the one who let their idol escape. The account that wins is that of the second step: international and less high-profile champions who score almost the same in half. And if your opponent pretends to know, hit him with an obscure name: his face will tell you if he's bluffing.

ocio.titulo: Leisure and gaming themes for Draft 20
intro: Video games, consoles, collecting and iconic mobile phones: the most generational category and, probably, the one that brings up the most anecdotes during the game.
Themes to play with someone your age and win (or lose) due to details that only you remember, from GTA VI to Tamagotchi.
ocio.truco: Leisure is generational memory: those who lived through the era pay more for their icons. If you share an age, the duel is fair and the bank wins; if there is a difference, exploit your decade (you know every reference) and inflate his (he will pay for nostalgia what is not worth in stars).

fantasia.titulo: Fantasy and adventure themes for Draft 20
intro: Zombies, pirates, Vikings, samurai and cowboys: adventure themes with items ranging from legendary treasure to completely useless objects. Here Ragnar Lodbrok coexists with a leaky longship.
It is the perfect category for those who play role-playing games, watch historical series or simply enjoy imagining an adventure with what they are wearing.
fantasia.truco: In fantasy, no one knows for sure what each rarity is worth, so you play the rival, not the list: spend little, inflate a lot and save your coins for the end. Items with a legendary name are always outbid; let them go and stay with the humble ones who close a team for a coin.

ciencia.titulo: Science and technology themes for Draft 20
intro: Themes for the curious: space missions and movie robots. Few items by theme, but with some of the most iconic in the game.
It works very well against rivals who like to explain why Hubble is better than James Webb while bidding.
ciencia.truco: With such short lists, each item weighs twice as much: there are no filler rounds to hide behind. If your rival pontificates about an item, it's usually because he wants it: raise it ruthlessly and drop out in time. And never end up without coins at the end, which is where the real icons come out.

naturaleza.titulo: Nature and animal themes for Draft 20
intro: From the savanna to the farm: themes with pets, dinosaurs and camping. It is the category with the most disparate items, from the wild lion to the pet cockroach.
Ideal for playing with the family or for those who are always planning the next getaway.
naturaleza.truco: Nature mixes the adorable with the absurd, and people excel at grace (the lion, the dino) while disdaining the useful. Take advantage of the monkey bias: let the rival spend on pets and keep the discreet ones who score silently.

crimen.titulo: Crime and Mystery Themes for Draft 20
intro: Impossible heists and legendary detectives: themes for those who enjoy detective stories. Here you bid the same for a brilliant hacker as for a digging spoon.
A nod to robbery movies and classic detectives, with items that invite you to invent the story of the game while it is auctioned.
crimen.truco: Crime invites bluffing: since everything is mystery and intrigue, your aggressive bids seem like information. Pretend to know what each suspect is worth, inflate what your rival sees and remember that here he who talks a lot usually has little: silence also bids.

hamburguesa.descripcion: The original theme of Draft 20 and the one that best explains the game: here you bid for Wagyu beef, black truffle and brioche bread while someone tries to sneak in an industrial orange cheese or a meat that releases fat. It plays like a burger discussion taken to the limit, where spending too early on the crispy bacon can leave you with nothing for the main course. In between appear caramelized onion, Hass avocado and fried egg, ingredients that separate a memorable burger from a sad single pickle. Ideal as a first game: everyone understands each item instantly and the auction is decided by pure strategy.

preguntas.q: Does Wagyu and truffle appear in the burger theme?
preguntas.a: Yes, both are among the most coveted items and usually decide the game if someone bids wisely.

preguntas.q: What is the worst burger item?
preguntas.a: Industrial orange cheese and fatty meat: they serve to inflate bids, but no one wants them on their team.

preguntas.q: Is it a good theme to learn to play?
preguntas.a: The best: each ingredient is recognized instantly, so you can focus on learning to bid, stand, and read your opponent.

preguntas.q: How many ingredients are there per game?
preguntas.a: Eight of the twenty, drawn by levels: there is always good meat and some punishment, but you never know in what order.

hamburguesa.tactica: In the hamburger, the starting order rules: if the Wagyu or the truffle appear early, many bleed to death and the rest of the game is played with pocket change. The profitable move is to let your rival pay for the hazing of the first big item while you close with reasonably priced brioche, aged cheddar, and bacon. Use industrial cheese and raw bread to inflate: raise them one at a time when your rival hesitates and lower yourself before keeping them. And remember the rule of thirds: reaching round 5 with less than 7 coins here is giving away the truffle.

tapas.descripcion: From acorn-fed Iberian ham to Galician-style octopus, this theme recreates the perfect bar of a Spanish bar: juicy tortilla, homemade croquettes, garlic prawns and cured Manchego cheese compete with well-poured draft beer and summer red wine. It also includes the bar classics that no one wants: the last olive on the plate, the rubber squid, the dry tortilla and that canned ham that puts the house to shame. It is the most Spanish theme in the catalog and one of the most balanced, because the good items are distributed among many rounds and there is almost always a possible comeback. Ideal for playing with hunger, even if it is a tactical error.

preguntas.q: What good items appear in Tapas and Bar?
preguntas.a: The Iberian ham, the juicy omelette, the homemade croquettes and the Galician-style octopus are the most disputed.

preguntas.q: What are the worst items on the bar?
preguntas.a: The last olive, rubber squid and canned ham: perfect for inflating other people's bids, horrible for your team.

preguntas.q: Are there drinks in the theme?
preguntas.a: Yes: well-drafted cane and tinto de Verano are also auctioned, and they usually come out cheaper than they are worth.

preguntas.q: Why is it good for coming back?
preguntas.a: Because the value is distributed: rarely do two gems come out in a row, so saving for last almost always pays off.

tapas.tactica: Tapas reward patience: the Iberian ham tempts in any round, but paying a premium price leaves you out of the octopus and croquettes. Play both sides with drinks, which usually go unnoticed and close the team at a good price. When a bar punishment comes out (olive, rubber squid), inflate without fear one by one: the rival, with simulated hunger, almost always bites. And always save 5 or 6 coins for the last two rounds, where the omelette or octopus usually fall.

pizza.descripcion: The theme of real pizza: melted cheese and natural tomato always on the table, with spicy pepperoni, serrano ham, fresh mushrooms, 48-hour sourdough, a Neapolitan wood oven and a stuffed edge that changes everything, compared to the frozen dough, the grated cheese that does not melt and the ketchup on top. The contrast between the artisan and the tacky is what makes this auction so fun, and the controversial pineapple guarantees discussion in every game. It is the most played theme in the catalog along with soccer: even those who never play know it, the games last five minutes and there is always a rematch with a different flavor.

preguntas.q: Do cheese and tomato always come out?
preguntas.a: Yes, they are the non-negotiable basis of the theme: they appear in all games, and the rest of the ingredients are drawn around.

preguntas.q: Does pineapple really come out on pizza?
preguntas.a: Yes, with all the controversy included: it is a medium item that divides each couple and usually decides bids more out of pride than strategy.

preguntas.q: Which artisan ingredient is most worth it?
preguntas.a: The wood oven, the sourdough and the stuffed edge are usually the most fought over, because they transform any pizza.

preguntas.q: What are the worst ingredients?
preguntas.a: Frozen dough, bagged cheese that doesn't melt, and sachet ketchup: ideal for inflation, fatal for your team.

pizza.tactica: Pizza is played at two speeds: the artisanal ingredients (pepperoni, ham, stuffed edge) really fight and the cheap ones serve to inflate. Since cheese and tomatoes always come out, don't spend more on them than necessary: save the coins for the ingredient that completes your team. If your rival is craving the pepperoni, take it up one at a time and drop out before he eats it all.

barbacoa.descripcion: The Sunday BBQ turned into an auction: ribeye aged 45 days, brisket smoked twelve hours, oak embers, homemade chimichurri, BBQ ribs and a cast iron grill in front of a moist charcoal, some pre-cooked sausages or a charred meat. It is the most "after-dinner" theme of all, perfect to play while making real food, with cold beer as a wild card item that always encourages bidding. In between, Moorish skewers, Creole chorizo and roasted corn complete a grill where almost everything is desired and almost everything can be paid dearly on impulse.

preguntas.q: What makes Sunday Asado special?
preguntas.a: Good items reward those who know how to wait: the steak and the brisket usually come out together and force you to divide the budget.

preguntas.q: What is the best cut on the grill?
preguntas.a: The ribeye matured for 45 days, closely followed by the twelve-hour brisket: these are the two items that decide games.

preguntas.q: What does beer look like at a barbecue?
preguntas.a: Cold beer is a medium item that usually comes out cheap and closes teams: never ignore it in the last rounds.

preguntas.q: What are the punishments of the grill?
preguntas.a: Wet charcoal, charred meat and precooked sausages: the trio that ruins any after-dinner meal.

barbacoa.tactica: The barbecue punishes the impulsive: the steak tempts as soon as it comes out, but if you pay a crazy price for it you'll be left watching your rival take brisket and ribs. Let the opponent get excited about the first big cut and attack the second, which usually comes out cheaper out of pure fear. Oak embers and chimichurri are tricky items: they are worth more than they seem and almost no one fights for them. And it inflates with the wet coal without mercy, that with hunger everything seems edible.

sushi.descripcion: Bar-level sushi: otoro, hamachi nigiri, fresh shaved wasabi, premium sake, koshihikari rice and even the itamae master himself enter the auction. On the other side of the bar wait the fake crab surimi, the tube wasabi, the generic soy sauce, the plastic supermarket tray and the reused chopsticks. The favorite theme of those who boast of their palate, and also of those who only want to see the one who boasts fall: the contrast between ikura's gunkan and yesterday's leftovers is the cruelest in the catalog. With pickled ginger and matcha tea in between, each round tastes like an expensive restaurant.

preguntas.q: Does itamae master appear as an item?
preguntas.a: Yes, the itamae is one of the most valuable items: it is bid on as if it were a signing.

preguntas.q: What's the best bite at the bar?
preguntas.a: The otoro, followed by the hamachi nigiri and the ikura gunkan: the trio that decides almost all the games.

preguntas.q: What bad items does sushi have?
preguntas.a: Fake surimi, tube wasabi, stale rice and reused chopsticks: punishments with a lot of personality.

preguntas.q: Do you need to understand sushi to play?
preguntas.a: No: it is enough to know that fresh is valid and plastic is not. The rest is provided by the auction.

sushi.tactica: Sushi is played with the rival's palate in mind: if he boasts of knowledge, let him pay for the otoro at Michelin star prices while you close with hamachi, sake and braised salmon. The itamae is the perfect bait for a war of egos: raise it three at a time until you feel the tremor and plant the ME BASS at the right moment. And don't despise koshihikari rice or tamagoyaki, average items that almost no one fights for and that round out winning teams.

postres.descripcion: Tiramisu, chocolate coulant, Basque cheesecake, cheesecake and Nutella cookies compete for the position of best ending to the meal, with churros with chocolate, walnut brownie and colorful macarons completing the display case. In between, a sachet flan, a frozen cake, sprayed cream and a melted cake that no one wants to even look at. It is one of the fastest themes to play and one that allows for the most comebacks, because the good items are distributed throughout all the rounds and sugar clouds judgment. The favorite to play after dinner with coffee in hand.

preguntas.q: What is the most desired dessert of the theme?
preguntas.a: The coulant and tiramisu tend to raise the most bids, with the Basque cheesecake close behind.

preguntas.q: What bad desserts can ruin me?
preguntas.a: The sachet flan, the frozen cake and the melted cake: if you eat them because they are inflated too much, it hurts.

preguntas.q: Why are there so many comebacks here?
preguntas.a: Because the good stuff comes out spread over the eight rounds: whoever saves for last almost always finds their dessert.

preguntas.q: Do churros with chocolate score well?
preguntas.a: Better than it seems: it is a medium-high item that almost no one seriously fights for and comes at a good price.

postres.tactica: The desserts are a sugar marathon: don't spend your budget on the coulant in round 2 because the tiramisu hasn't come out yet. The winning tactic is to snack on mediums (macarons, brownies, cinnamon rolls) while the rival eats the first jewel, and finish off with the Basque cake at the end. The envelope flan is your best inflation weapon: everyone despises it out loud and almost everyone bites if you raise it with a serious face. Be careful with the cap of 4: with so much candy distributed it is easy to close early and give away the last rounds.

cerveza.descripcion: Cloudy IPA, Bavarian wheat, berry lambic, creamy oak barrel-aged stout versus the watery lager, the shandy, the warm beer, the cork flavor and the dirty glass. The craft theme of the catalog: fresh pint from the tap, toasted with honey, amber malt and wood-smoked for those who understand, and a dented can for the rest. Quick game, quick laughs and instant rematch, ideal for playing beforehand or between real rounds. The favorite of those who order by looking at the tap board.

preguntas.q: Is the whole theme craft beer?
preguntas.a: Almost: the selection draws on recognizable craft styles, and bad items are just what ruins a good beer.

preguntas.q: What is the jewel of the menu?
preguntas.a: The one aged in oak barrels, with the cloudy IPA and the Bavarian wheat on its heels.

preguntas.q: What is the worst thing that can happen to you?
preguntas.a: Hot beer in a dirty glass with a cork flavor: the triptych of beer horror.

preguntas.q: Is it good for a quick pre-game?
preguntas.a: It's perfect: five minutes per game and instant rematch, just as long as a round lasts.

cerveza.tactica: Beer is drunk fast and bid on even faster: games fly by because almost no one hesitates when an IPA is on the table. Use your rival's speed: inflate the oak barrel with +3 raises that look like beer enthusiasm, then pull out cold. The draft pint and the honey toast are safe mid-price values that almost no one contests. And if the dented can or the flat one comes up, don't touch them even to inflate: some rivals will drink them out of pride and leave you holding the punishment.

tacos.descripcion: Tacos al pastor, birria with consommé, cochinita pibil, carnitas and homemade guacamole against the broken tortilla, the jarred sauce, the wilted lettuce and the cold taco. The Mexican theme of the catalog: here cheese and tomato do not rule, the corn tortilla rules, and the broken tortilla is the definitive punishment. In between, fish taco, shrimp taco, chicharrón, chopped onion, fresh cilantro and brava red sauce complete a taqueria where the spicy food is paid separately and you suffer for free. With horchata to put out the fire, it is the tastiest theme to play with a craving.

preguntas.q: Do the tortilla and al pastor always come out?
preguntas.a: Yes, they are the non-negotiable basis of the theme, just like cheese and tomato on pizza.

preguntas.q: Which taco is king?
preguntas.a: Al pastor rules, with birria consommé and cochinita pibil completing the podium.

preguntas.q: What is the worst thing about the taqueria?
preguntas.a: The broken tortilla and the greasy cold taco: if you drop them, the game gets very complicated.

preguntas.q: Does brava red sauce really sting?
preguntas.a: At the auction it stings in coins: it's a mid-tier item that usually goes for more than it's worth out of pure pride.

tacos.tactica: Tacos are played with hunger and a cool head at the same time: al pastor tempts from the first round, but birria and cochinita decide more games for fewer coins. Since the corn tortilla always comes out, don't overpay for it: it's a base, not a jewel. Jarred sauce and the broken tortilla are your inflation weapons, because no real Mexican lets them pass without bidding out of pride. And watch out for the cold greasy taco: it seems harmless and it's the item that has ruined the most games with one extra +1.

freidora_aire.descripcion: Crispy potatoes, juicy wings, creamy croquettes, homemade churros and golden nuggets versus burnt everything, soft potatoes, rubbery nuggets and raw croquettes. The viral appliance theme: everything that goes well in the fryer (roasted vegetables, rare salmon, reheated pizza, dumplings, crispy bacon, omelette) and everything that goes wrong, including the mid-program blackout and the cold basket. It is the most domestic theme in the catalog and one of the most fun to play with the family, because everyone has a kitchen disaster story.

preguntas.q: Do churros really come out in an air fryer?
preguntas.a: Yes, and they are among the most bided on items: crispy on the outside and made in minutes.

preguntas.q: What's the best thing that comes out of the fryer?
preguntas.a: Crispy potatoes and juicy wings lead, with churros and creamy croquettes trailing behind.

preguntas.q: What happens if the power goes out halfway through?
preguntas.a: It's a punishment item: if you take it, it's like dining in the dark. Use it to inflate, never to keep it on.

preguntas.q: Is it suitable for playing with children?
preguntas.a: A lot: the items are understood without explanation and the disasters make people laugh at any age.

freidora_aire.tactica: The fryer rewards those who cook calmly: the potatoes and wings are expensive if you fight them early, but the churros and croquettes usually fall halfway through the game at a reasonable price. The trick is to let the opponent keep the first fried star and attack the second with the bank intact. Everything is burnt and rubber nuggets are perfect bait for bluffs: no one wants them, so a serious bid is really scary. And keep an eye on the cold basket: it looks like a joke and is the dumbest coin theft in the catalog.

peliculas.descripcion: Masterpieces against legendary disasters: The Godfather, Pulp Fiction, Interstellar, Back to the Future, Titanic, Matrix, Jurassic Park, Rocky, Terminator 2 and Gladiator compete in the same auction with Morbius, Emoji: The Movie, Dragonball Evolution, Cats, Sharknado and The Room. It is a theme for movie buffs, but also for those who enjoy bidding on a bad movie only so that their rival doesn't have it. In between, City of God, Godzilla and Ben-Hur separate those who have seen movies from those who have only seen premieres. Each bid brings a debate about what is a masterpiece and what is a crime against celluloid.

preguntas.q: What bad movies come out in the theme?
preguntas.a: Morbius, Emoji: The Movie and Dragonball Evolution are the items that no one wants, although sometimes it is convenient to bid on them to spend little.

preguntas.q: What is the most valuable movie?
preguntas.a: The Godfather usually leads, with Pulp Fiction and Interstellar competing against him every game.

preguntas.q: Is The Room good or bad here?
preguntas.a: Bad of the legends: it is so disastrous that there are those who bid on it for the love of crappy cinema.

preguntas.q: Do you have to be a movie buff to play?
preguntas.a: No: it is enough to recognize titles. Those who have not seen City of God leave it cheap and there is the business.

peliculas.tactica: Cinema rewards those who feign ignorance: if the rival is a cinephile, let him bleed over The Godfather while you close with Back to the Future, Rocky and Gladiator at half price. Bad movies are gold for inflation: no one admits to wanting Morbius, but almost everyone bids "to do harm" and eats it. And attack the covered ones (City of God, Ben-Hur): gems that the solo-Blockbusters miss and that win games silently.

series.descripcion: Breaking Bad, The Sopranos, The Wire and Chernobyl are the heavyweights; Game of Thrones, Stranger Things, Dark and Peaky Blinders complete the noble zone, with Physics or Chemistry, Rebel Way, Riverdale, Emily in Paris, The Idol, Velma and 13 Reasons Why as the price to pay for such a good theme. Those who have seen a lot believe they have an advantage, until they have to decide whether to bid on Netflix's Cowboy Bebop or Inhumans. In between, The Office, Friends, Rick and Morty and La Casa de Papel are safe values that almost no one fights enough. The theme that generates the most couch discussions per minute.

preguntas.q: What is the most valuable series in the theme?
preguntas.a: Breaking Bad is usually the most disputed, although The Sopranos and The Wire raise similar bids.

preguntas.q: What bad series come out?
preguntas.a: Velma, The Idol, Inhumans and 13 Reasons Why: the punishment poker that no one wants on their team.

preguntas.q: Is Game of Thrones worth much here?
preguntas.a: A lot, but with a catch: almost everyone overvalues it out of nostalgia and it comes out more expensive than it pays.

preguntas.q: Do sitcoms rate well?
preguntas.a: The Office and Friends are medium-high items that tend to be cheap because no one takes them seriously. Mistake.

series.tactica: The series are played with the control of hype: Breaking Bad and Chernobyl are always very expensive, so let the rival pay for the novelty and stick with The Wire and The Sopranos, which decide the same thing for less. Bad series are your inflators: pretend to defend Emily in Paris with passion and watch how your rival pays to take away a punishment. And do not despise There is no one who lives here: the patriotic factor makes it perform above its price in almost all games.

anime.descripcion: Death Note, Fullmetal Alchemist Brotherhood, Attack on Titan, Naruto, Demon Slayer, Jujutsu Kaisen, Evangelion and Cowboy Bebop lead a theme that also pays tribute to One Punch Man, Berserk '97, Sailor Moon and Vinland Saga. On the dark side await Ex-Arm, School Days, Boku no Pico, Mars of Destruction, Hand Shakers and Pupa, with 2016's Berserk serving as a reminder that even good things can go wrong. It is the most recommended theme to play with someone who "does not watch anime": the bad items are more fun for them than for the fans, and My Hero Academia and My Hero Academia aside, everything is decided by bidding without complexes.

preguntas.q: Do you need to know anime to play well?
preguntas.a: No: bidding works just as well with name recognition alone, and bad items are part of the fun.

preguntas.q: What is the most valuable anime?
preguntas.a: Fullmetal Alchemist Brotherhood and Death Note usually lead, with Attack on Titan close behind.

preguntas.q: What's the worst that can happen?
preguntas.a: Ex-Arm, Pupa and Boku no Pico: the anime trinity that no one defends even as a joke.

preguntas.q: How is it different from Modern Anime?
preguntas.a: This brings together historical figures from all eras; Modern Anime is only the 2024-2026 batch.

anime.tactica: Classic anime is fandom war: each player overrates their childhood series, so let the rival pay the nostalgia tax for Naruto or Evangelion while you close with Vinland Saga, Cowboy Bebop and Jujutsu Kaisen. The infamous punishments (Ex-Arm, Pupa) are brutal inflators because no otaku admits even looking at them. And be careful with Sailor Moon and My Hero Academia: items that "experts" despise and that win games at a bargain price.

comics.descripcion: Watchmen, Maus, Akira, Sandman, Persepolis, Hellboy and Invincible form a luxury podium, with Tintin, Asterix, Mortadelo and Filemón and the Ninja Turtles in the area loved by everyone. The contrast is provided by All-Star Batman & Robin, Ultimatum, Marville, Youngblood and Batman: Odyssey, comics that the community remembers for no good reasons. The perfect theme for those who show off their bookshelves and those who have only seen the movies: Garfield and The Boys serve as a bridge between both worlds. Each bid is a discussion about what is sequential art and what is a dead letter.

preguntas.q: Is it a theme only for comics experts?
preguntas.a: No, although experts enjoy it more: the items are known enough to bid without having read the comics.

preguntas.q: What is the most valuable comic?
preguntas.a: Watchmen usually leads, with Maus and Akira completing an almost immovable podium.

preguntas.q: What is the worst thing about the drawer?
preguntas.a: All-Star Batman & Robin and Ultimatum: famous for being bad, perfect for inflating bids.

preguntas.q: Do Europeans score well?
preguntas.a: Tintin, Asterix and Persepolis perform above their price: Americanists let them pass and it is a mistake.

comics.tactica: The comic plays two libraries: let the rival fight over Watchmen and Sandman while you take Persepolis, Hellboy and Invincible, who decide the same in half. Legendary disasters (All-Star Batman, Ultimatum) are ideal bluff bait: feign ironic collecting and cash in on the joke. And don't forget Mortadelo and Filemón: the patriotic factor makes them always perform above expectations in Spanish games.

libros.descripcion: From Don Quixote to 1984, passing through One Hundred Years of Solitude, The Lord of the Rings, Crime and Punishment, Pride and Prejudice, Frankenstein, Dracula, The Hobbit and Moby Dick: it is the most "respectable" theme in the catalog... until Twilight, Fifty Shades, After, Boulevard and a Wattpad novel appear. The auction ends up being a public confession of embarrassing readings, with The Da Vinci Code and World War Z as a gray area where no one can agree. Between La Celestina, The Metamorphosis and The Shadow of the Wind, each round is a tricky general knowledge exam.

preguntas.q: Which book usually generates the most bids?
preguntas.a: Don Quixote and One Hundred Years of Solitude are vying for first place, with 1984 very close.

preguntas.q: What is the worst book on the list?
preguntas.a: The Wattpad novel and Boulevard are fighting for the lantern, with After and Twilight lurking.

preguntas.q: Are modern bestsellers worth anything?
preguntas.a: The Da Vinci Code and The Shadow of the Wind are misleading media: they are worth more than purists admit.

preguntas.q: Do I need to have read them all?
preguntas.a: No: it is enough to know which ones are untouchable. No one has read Moby Dick in its entirety and everyone knows it.

libros.tactica: Books reward the cultured faker: let your rival pay for Don Quixote at manuscript price while you close with 1984, Frankenstein and Dracula, which perform equally well for less. Twilight and After are luxury inflators: no one defends them in public, but almost everyone bids "to spite" and keeps them. And go after La Celestina and The Metamorphosis, classics that best-seller-only readers ignore and leave cheap.

musica.descripcion: Queen, The Beatles, AC/DC, the Stones, Nirvana, Pink Floyd, Metallica, Eminem and Bob Marley in the same auction, with Quevedo, Aitana, Lola Índigo and Sabina as national representation. The punishment is given by Lulu from Metallica and Lou Reed, Chikilicuatre from Eurovision, Las Ketchup, Lou Bega, Crazy Frog, LMFAO and Justin Bieber from the Baby era. It's a conversation starter: each bid brings a discussion about albums, concerts and eras, and the PSY of Gangnam Style always appears when he is least expected. The most intergenerational after pop_stars: grandparents and grandchildren bid without understanding each other and with the same coins.

preguntas.q: Does Spanish music appear in the theme?
preguntas.a: Yes, there are patriotic and Eurovision nods among the items, including some classic musical highlights.

preguntas.q: What is the most valuable group?
preguntas.a: Queen and The Beatles usually lead, with AC/DC and the Stones in the same echelon.

preguntas.q: What's the worst that can happen?
preguntas.a: El Chikilicuatre and Crazy Frog fight for the honor, with Las Ketchup always on the lookout.

preguntas.q: Do the current ones compete with the classics?
preguntas.a: Quevedo and Aitana perform well among young people, but almost never at the price of a Beatle.

musica.tactica: Music is played by generations: if your rival is a classic player, let Queen pay at the original vinyl price and stick with Eminem, Bob Marley and Sabina, who close teams for less. Chikilicuatre and Crazy Frog are your inflators: other people's shame bids alone. And don't despise PSY or Lou Bega, meme items that come cheap and perform better than they sound. As always, whoever gets excited about the first big one loses the entire auction.

karaoke.descripcion: Bohemian Rhapsody, Despacito, YMCA, My Way, Bailando, Total Eclipse of the Heart, Sweet Caroline, Macarena, Wannabe and Superstition are the items that everyone wants to have to sing at the end. In front, La Mayonesa, El Baile del Gorila, Chihuahua, Holiday Rap and Happy Birthday as historical punishment, with Barbie Girl, La Bamba, Aserejé and Sopa de Cacol as a total party zone. Playing this theme while someone sings each item that comes out is a different experience: the auction becomes a concert and whoever goes out of tune pays the price twice. The favorite for group nights.

preguntas.q: What is the most searched item in Karaoke?
preguntas.a: Bohemian Rhapsody, almost always: it is the one that raises the most bids and the one that is sung the most at the end of the game.

preguntas.q: What is the worst karaoke song?
preguntas.a: El Baile del Gorila and La Mayonesa compete for the title, with Chihuahua completing the horror podium.

preguntas.q: Is the Macarena worth a lot?
preguntas.a: More than anyone admits: it is a medium-high value that comes cheap out of shame and performs quietly.

preguntas.q: Do you have to really sing?
preguntas.a: It is not mandatory, but singing each auctioned item is the house rule that turns the game into legend.

karaoke.tactica: Karaoke is sung and bid from the heart: let your rival ruin themselves with Bohemian Rhapsody while you close with My Way, Sweet Caroline and Wannabe, anthems that come out at half the price. El Baile del Gorila and La Mayonesa are perfect inflators because no one wants them but everyone sings the chorus. And go after Superstition and Total Eclipse: great songs that reggaeton-only players ignore and leave cheap.

anime_moderno.descripcion: Gojo, Frieren, Itadori, Denji, Sukuna, Fern, Stark, Sung Jinwoo, Momo Ayase and Okarun lead the 2024-2026 batch of anime: Jujutsu Kaisen, Frieren, Chainsaw Man, Solo Leveling and Dan Da Dan in the same auction, with Reze, Pochita, Rimuru, Igris and Ai Hoshino completing the recent elite. The punishment is delivered by Kazuya Kinoshita, Mami Nanami, Ruka Sarashina and the reincarnated vending machine, with Anya Forger and Power as adorable wild cards. The theme for those who keep up with the seasons and discuss the latest episode every Monday. Nostalgia doesn't matter here: only what's on air.

preguntas.q: How is it different from classic Anime?
preguntas.a: Anime brings together the historical ones; Modern Anime is just the recent batch, with series that are still airing.

preguntas.q: Who is the most sought-after character?
preguntas.a: Gojo usually leads, with Frieren and Sukuna challenging him every game.

preguntas.q: What is the worst thing about baking?
preguntas.a: Kazuya Kinoshita and the vending machine: punishments that even fans recognize as such.

preguntas.q: Is Anya Forger worth a lot?
preguntas.a: More than it seems: it is an average value that comes cheap and brightens up any team.

anime_moderno.tactica: Modern anime is speed: the series are broadcast and the values are set by the weekly hype, so the rival overpays for what they saw yesterday. Let Gojo pay at cover price while you close with Frieren, Stark and Fern, who perform equally well for less. Kazuya and the vending girl are textbook inflators: no one defends them. And go after Igris and Rimuru, items that shonen-only fans are unaware of and leave at a bargain price.

villanos.descripcion: Hannibal Lecter, Sauron, Pennywise, Freddy Krueger, Anton Chigurh, Maleficent, Hans Landa, Norman Bates, Chucky and Jason Voorhees: four different ways to be scary in the same auction, from elegant horror to pure slasher. The counterpoint is provided by Lord Farquaad, Amy Dunne and Regina George, everyday villains who are scarier than many monsters, and a second line of Marvel that no one remembers (Galactus cloud, Steppenwolf, Doomsday, Dark Phoenix, Malekith, Enchantress, Venom from Spider-Man 3). The theme is completed with second-rate villains who create the most fun contrast in the catalog: real terror against the filler bad guy.

preguntas.q: Who is the most valuable villain?
preguntas.a: Hannibal Lecter and Sauron are usually the most coveted, far ahead of filler villains.

preguntas.q: What are Regina George or Lord Farquaad doing here?
preguntas.a: They are everyday villains of great meme value: they perform more than their appearance suggests.

preguntas.q: Who is the worst villain on the list?
preguntas.a: Malekith and Enchantress dispute the title: not even Marvel fans defend them.

preguntas.q: Is it scary to play it at night?
preguntas.a: Only if you get Pennywise three times in a row. Otherwise, it is the most fun theme for Halloween.

villanos.tactica: The villains reward the one who distinguishes filler terror: let the rival pay Hannibal and Sauron while you close with Chigurh, Hans Landa and Norman Bates, who decide the same for less. The second row of Marvel (Steppenwolf, Malekith, Enchantress) is your inflation field: they sound like a threat and they are punishment. And don't look down on Regina George and Farquaad: the meme factor makes them outperform their price in almost every game.

simpsons.descripcion: Homer, Bart, Lisa, Marge, Ned Flanders, Krusty, Burns, Moe, Wiggum, Apu, Milhouse, Nelson, Grandpa, Maggie, Ralph, Skinner, Dr. Nick, Duffman and Barney lead an auction that also includes Gil Gunderson as the ultimate job punishment. It is a consensus theme: almost everyone recognizes each item, so the game is decided by strategy and not by knowledge. With the twins Sherri and Terri where appropriate and the entire Springfield bidding, it is one of the best entry doors to the game: the rules are learned in the first round and the bidding comes by itself. D'oh.

preguntas.q: Is it a good theme for the first game?
preguntas.a: It's one of the best: the items are instantly recognizable and the rules are learned by playing the first round.

preguntas.q: Who is the most valuable in Springfield?
preguntas.a: Homer usually leads, with Bart and Lisa rounding out a very stable podium.

preguntas.q: Who is the worst neighbor?
preguntas.a: Gil Gunderson: the failed salesman par excellence, official punishment of the theme.

preguntas.q: Do mythical secondary characters appear?
preguntas.a: Yes: Ralph, Dr. Nick, Duffman and Barney are medium items that bring a lot of life to the auction.

simpsons.tactica: The Simpsons make everyone equal: since no one has a knowledge advantage, pure bankroll management wins. Don't pay the protagonist's price for Homer in round 1: Bart, Lisa and Marge perform almost the same and come out cheaper when the rival has already spent. Gil is your inflator: everyone has been Gil at some point and almost everyone bites. And go after the beloved supporting characters (Ralph, Duffman, Dr. Nick): collective affection makes them perform above their price.

disney.descripcion: Mickey Mouse, Simba, Elsa, Genie, Woody, Stitch, Buzz Lightyear, Moana, Rapunzel, Dumbo, Mulan and Pinocchio compete with Scar, Ursula, Pete, Jafar, Cruella de Vil and Captain Hook. The favorite theme to play with the family: children recognize the protagonists and adults discuss whether Elsa is worth more than Simba, while Peter Pan flies over the auction. Watch out for Sid from Toy Story (here as Gus and company): the item that no one wants but everyone knows. With the magic of childhood in every round, it is impossible to play without smiling, even losing.

preguntas.q: Can it be played with children?
preguntas.a: Yes, it is one of the most familiar themes in the catalog: all the items are recognizable characters and the rules are simple.

preguntas.q: Who is the most valuable in the kingdom?
preguntas.a: Mickey and Simba usually lead, with Elsa and Genie close behind in the bidding.

preguntas.q: Are villains worth anything?
preguntas.a: Scar and Ursula are medium-high values: children fear them and adults fight them.

preguntas.q: What is the factory's punishment?
preguntas.a: Gus and the forgotten supporting characters: items that only serve to inflate with a face of innocence.

disney.tactica: Disney is pure childhood excitement: your opponent overpays for their childhood character, so identify which one it is before round 3 and squeeze it out of them. Let him ruin himself with Elsa or Simba while you close with the Genie, Woody and Stitch, who perform the same for less. The villains (Scar, Ursula, Jafar) are excellent bait for competitive parents. And if you play with children, let them win the first one: they are hooked forever and the rematch is yours.

marvel_dc.descripcion: Spider-Man, Batman, Iron Man, Wolverine, Thanos, Superman, Hulk, Captain America, Thor and Joker in the same auction, with Black Widow, Doctor Strange and Harley Quinn completing the elite. The punishment is given by Howard the Duck, Matter-Eater Lad, Arm-Fall-Off-Boy, Polka-Dot Man, Egghead, Kite Man and Condiment King: heroes and villains so ridiculous that they are legendary for it. It is the dream theme to discuss superheroes, and also the one that quickly makes it clear which of the two watches more cape films. Each bid is a playground versus coins.

preguntas.q: What weird villains or heroes come out?
preguntas.a: Howard the Duck and Matter-Eater Lad are the funniest bad items, perfect for ruining someone's strategy.

preguntas.q: Who is the most powerful in the auction?
preguntas.a: Spider-Man and Batman usually lead, with Iron Man and the Joker rounding out the poker.

preguntas.q: What is Matter-Eater Lad?
preguntas.a: A DC hero whose power is to eat any matter: at the auction he is punishment with pedigree.

preguntas.q: Mix Marvel and DC?
preguntas.a: Yes, by the way: the fun is confronting universes that never intersect in cinema.

marvel_dc.tactica: Superheroes are egos with capes: let your rival pay the fan tax for Batman or Spider-Man while you close with Thor, Hulk and the Joker, who perform the same for less. The ridiculous ones (Polka-Dot Man, Condiment King, Arm-Fall-Off-Boy) are gold pumpers: no one wants them but everyone laughs while bidding. And go after Black Widow and Doctor Strange: secondary characters that movie-only fans undervalue and sell at a bargain price.

dragon_ball.descripcion: Goku, Vegeta, Frieza, Gohan, Cell, Majin Buu, Piccolo, Trunks, Bulma and Android 18 are the star items, with Mr. Satan, Krillin, Ten Shin Han, Yamcha and Yajirobe in the zone of beloved but limited warriors. The punishment is given by Chiaotzu, Bacterian, Garlic Jr., Emperor Pilaf and Ox-King. The theme is an exercise in nostalgia: each bid brings up a childhood memory, a discussion about sagas and transformations, and the eternal question of whether Yamcha even deserves to be there. With power levels everywhere, it's impossible not to shout out the first Kamehameha of the auction.

preguntas.q: Is Frieza in the auction?
preguntas.a: Yes, and it is usually one of the most disputed: he is the most recognizable villain in the series and attracts many bids.

preguntas.q: Who is the strongest?
preguntas.a: Goku and Vegeta lead, with Gohan and Cell rounding out the podium for each match.

preguntas.q: Why is Yamcha a meme?
preguntas.a: For always losing in a humiliating way: in the auction it is a medium-low item with a lot of affection.

preguntas.q: Mr. Satan worth anything?
preguntas.a: More than it seems: he is the official world champion and it is cheaper than his fame.

dragon_ball.tactica: Dragon Ball is nostalgia with a monkey's tail: the rival pays more for their favorite saga, so let it be ruined with Goku or Vegeta and close with Piccolo, Trunks and Android 18. Chiaotzu and Bacterian are perfect inflators because no one defends them even out of affection. And go after Bulma and Mr. Satan: non-fighters that purists despise and who win games for a laugh.

one_piece.descripcion: Luffy, Zoro, Shanks, Nami, Nico Robin, Sanji, Ace, Law, Usopp, Brook, Chopper, Franky and Jinbe against Spandam, Gecko Moria, Wapol, Foxy and Charloss. The theme for those who have been following the series for years and for those who only know the protagonist with a straw hat: the bad items are funny to both equally, because they are mean and ridiculous villains in equal parts. With Buggy the Clown as the chaotic wild and Big Mom and Kaido as fearsome emperors, each round is a miniature saga. The treasure is not One Piece: it is not keeping Spandam.

preguntas.q: Are there any One Piece spoilers?
preguntas.a: No: the items are recognizable characters and the game does not reveal anything about the plot.

preguntas.q: Who is the most valuable?
preguntas.a: Luffy and Shanks usually lead, with Zoro and Law close behind in the bidding.

preguntas.q: Who is Spandam?
preguntas.a: The most hated bureaucrat villain in the series: at the auction he is official punishment.

preguntas.q: Is Chopper worth a lot?
preguntas.a: More than what its appearance suggests: it is an average value that is cheap and always delivers.

one_piece.tactica: One Piece rewards the entire crew: let the rival pay Luffy at the price of a pirate king and set up your gang with Zoro, Sanji, Robin and Brook for fewer coins. Spandam and Wapol are ideal inflators because even non-fans hate them by hearsay. And go after Usopp, Chopper and Franky: the low band that anime-only players undervalue and that closes out championship teams.

harry_potter.descripcion: Harry, Dumbledore, Hermione, Snape, Voldemort, Hagrid, Ron, Sirius, McGonagall and Dobby counterpointed by Moaning Myrtle, Argus Filch, Neville, Aragog, Crabbe and Dudley. The most requested theme in the catalog among readers and film fans, with Draco, Ginny, Luna and Lockhart in the gray zone where the games are won. It is the one that generates the most debates about which character is really worth auctioning: is Ron's loyalty or Draco's cunning worth more? With Gilderoy Lockhart as a reminder that fame earns no points, every game is a crash course in Hogwarts.

preguntas.q: What is the most valuable item in Harry Potter?
preguntas.a: Dumbledore and Harry tend to be the highest bidders, with Snape almost always sneaking in on important decisions.

preguntas.q: Snape or Sirius?
preguntas.a: The eternal debate: Snape is usually more expensive, but Sirius performs better per coin in many games.

preguntas.q: Is Dobby a good item?
preguntas.a: Great and cheap: the elf that everyone loves and almost no one fights seriously.

preguntas.q: What is the worst thing about Hogwarts?
preguntas.a: Filch, Crabbe and Dudley: the trio of punishments that not even magic can save.

harry_potter.tactica: Hogwarts is played by houses: identify if your rival is from heroes or from Slytherin and exploit it with their side. Let them pay Harry or Dumbledore while you close with Hermione, McGonagall and Dobby, who perform equally well for less. Filch and Dudley are perfect inflators because no one defends them. And go after Luna and Neville: beloved secondary players who come out cheap and decide games in silence.

star_wars.descripcion: Darth Vader, Yoda, Luke, Leia, Han Solo, the Mandalorian, Obi-Wan, Chewbacca, R2-D2 and Grogu against Greedo, Watto, Jabba, Nute Gunray and the child Emperor Anakin. It works just as well with fans of the original trilogy as with those who grew up with the prequels or The Clone Wars: Ahsoka, BB-8, Lando and even Jar Jar Binks have their moment, and the bad items from the saga are so well known that bidding on them also has its charm. With Boba Fett as a luxury bounty hunter, each round is a battle between the light side, the dark side and the one who just wants to annoy the opponent.

preguntas.q: Is Jar Jar Binks out?
preguntas.a: The theme includes controversial items from the saga, although the most punished of all is usually Greedo.

preguntas.q: Vader or Yoda?
preguntas.a: Vader tends to be more expensive for pure dark charisma, but Yoda performs better for money spent.

preguntas.q: Is Grogu worth much?
preguntas.a: A lot and with a trick: his tenderness inflates bids beyond reason. Use it to inflate, not to pay for it.

preguntas.q: What is the worst thing about the galaxy?
preguntas.a: Greedo, Watto and the child Anakin: punishments that not even the Force can save.

star_wars.tactica: The galaxy is divided into trilogies: let the rival pay for his childhood (Vader for the classics, Mandalorian for the new ones) and close with Obi-Wan, Leia and Chewbacca, eternal secondary players who perform for less. Greedo and Watto are textbook inflators: nobody wants them. And attack R2-D2, Lando and Ahsoka: characters that the movie-only ones overlook and who win games.

pokemon.descripcion: Pikachu, Charizard, Mewtwo, Gengar, Dragonite, Snorlax, Gyarados, Eevee, Greninja, Lucario and Arceus are the favorites, with Blastoise, Venusaur, Magikarp and Mr. Mime in the zone of debatable classics. The punishment is given by Bidoof, Smeargle, Stunfisk, Meowth and Psyduck: items that no one wants but everyone knows. It's a mental list thing: everyone has a favorite Pokémon and everyone thinks theirs is the most valuable, so the auction turns into a clash of childhoods. With 151 reasons to argue, it's impossible to play without saying "I chose..." at least once.

preguntas.q: Why is Bidoof among the worst items?
preguntas.a: Because it has become a meme: it is a harmless Pokémon that the community uses to joke, and at the auction it fulfills the same role.

preguntas.q: Charizard or Pikachu?
preguntas.a: Charizard is almost always more expensive, but Pikachu performs better per coin in most games.

preguntas.q: Is Magikarp worth anything?
preguntas.a: Just as an expensive meme: its funny thing is that it evolves, but in the auction there are no evolutions. Use it to inflate.

preguntas.q: Is Mewtwo the best?
preguntas.a: One of the best, yes, along with Arceus: they are the ones who decide games when they come out.

pokemon.tactica: Pokémon is pure childhood: let the opponent pay their favorite starter (almost always Charizard) and assemble your team with Gengar, Dragonite, Gyarados and Lucario. Bidoof, Stunfisk and Smeargle are legendary pumpers - the meme bids alone. And attack Eevee, Snorlax and Mr. Mime: items that competitive people despise and that close champion teams at a candy price.

pop_stars.descripcion: Taylor Swift, Michael Jackson, Bad Bunny, Madonna, Beyoncé, Freddie Mercury, Rihanna, Drake, Bruno Mars and Shakira compete with Rosalía, Ariana Grande, Billie Eilish, Dua Lipa and Ed Sheeran in the current stars zone. The punishment comes from Rebecca Black, Vanilla Ice, Jedward, Milli Vanilli and Nickelback: items that hurt just to name. The most intergenerational theme in the catalog: the older ones bid on the classics and the younger ones on the current stars, so the game depends a lot on who plays. Each bid is a playlist war with coins.

preguntas.q: Who is the most disputed item?
preguntas.a: Taylor Swift and Michael Jackson usually lead the bids, with Bad Bunny close behind.

preguntas.q: Freddie Mercury or Beyoncé?
preguntas.a: Freddie is more expensive per legend, but Beyoncé performs better per coin in most games.

preguntas.q: What is the worst thing about the scenario?
preguntas.a: Rebecca Black and Jedward: punishments that not even nostalgia can save.

preguntas.q: Does Rosalía score well?
preguntas.a: Very good among the Spanish public: the patriotic factor makes it perform above its price.

pop_stars.tactica: Pop is demographics: if your rival is older, let them pay Michael Jackson and Madonna while you close with Bad Bunny, Rosalía and Billie Eilish. If your rival is young, reverse the move with Freddie and Beyoncé, who are left cheap by young people. Rebecca Black and Nickelback are universal inflators: no one defends them. And go after Bruno Mars and Ed Sheeran, safe values that almost no one fights seriously.

streamers.descripcion: Ibai Llanos, MrBeast, El Rubius, AuronPlay, TheGrefg, Kai Cenat, IlloJuan, IShowSpeed, xQc, Vegetta777, Willyrex and Ninja in an auction with Mangel, Shadoune, Elmilloor and Escardi as punishment. It's the natural theme for those who watch streams daily, and a pleasant surprise for those who don't, because the bad items are just as entertaining. With Lola Lolita, Spreen, YoSoyPlex and Dalas completing the line-up, each round is a coin game: is Ibai's prime worth more or Vegetta's perseverance? The answer is paid in the auction.

preguntas.q: Does Ibai appear in the streamer theme?
preguntas.a: Yes, it is one of the most bid-on items, along with MrBeast and El Rubius.

preguntas.q: MrBeast or Ibai?
preguntas.a: MrBeast is more expensive on a global scale, but Ibai performs better per currency in Spanish games.

preguntas.q: Who are Mangel and Shadoune?
preguntas.a: Creators remembered for controversies more than for content: in the auction they are official punishment.

preguntas.q: Are the old Twitch ones worth it?
preguntas.a: Willyrex and Vegetta are safe values that young people leave cheap: a historical mistake.

streamers.tactica: Streamers are communities: each player overrates their streamer, so spot yours and take advantage of it. Let him pay Ibai or Rubius while you close with Auron, Grefg, and IlloJuan. Mangel and Shadoune are perfect inflators: the salseo pushes itself. And attack Vegetta, Willyrex and Ninja: veterans that the new ones despise and who win games at the old subscriber price.

la_velada.descripcion: Ibai, IlloJuan, TheGrefg, Plex, RoRo, Rivers, Marta Díaz, Coscu, Rubius, Viruzz, Momo, Jagger, Perxitaa, Alana and Nissaxter get into the ring at La Cartuja with AuronPlay, Luzu, Ari Gameplays, Gaspi and Amouranth in the background, while the KO in the first round and the towel await the clueless. The theme of the annual Hispanic streaming event: it is refreshed with each edition, with new combatants, new main event and new performances. It is the most "live" theme in the catalog: it is best played by commenting on it out loud, with the imaginary chat shouting each bid.

preguntas.q: Does the theme change every year?
preguntas.a: It is refreshed with each edition of La Velada: new fighters, new main event and new performances.

preguntas.q: Who is the main event?
preguntas.a: It varies by edition, but the headliners (Ibai, Rivers, IlloJuan) tend to be the highest bidders.

preguntas.q: Should you have seen La Velada?
preguntas.a: No: the names are recognized the same, and the KO in the first round is funny without context.

preguntas.q: Do participants repeat?
preguntas.a: Some do, and their value changes with each edition depending on their combat: the theme lives with the event.

la_velada.tactica: La Velada is a spectacle: the rival pays more for their favorite streamer, so let them get excited about the main event and close with Viruzz, Momo and Jagger, real fighters who come out cheap. The KO in the first round is your inflator: nobody wants it but everyone talks about it. And go after Coscu, Luzu and Perxitaa: veterans of the event that the new ones do not value and who deliver in silence.

kpop.descripcion: BTS, BLACKPINK, Jungkook, Jimin, Stray Kids, j-hope, Twice, aespa, NewJeans, IVE, LE SSERAFIM, SEVENTEEN, TXT, ENHYPEN, ITZY and IU newcomers, facing the false entrance, the out-of-tune playback, the nugu group of the year, the expelled trainee and the failed sub-unit. The theme of the most organized fandoms on the planet: here you bid with your heart and pay with your wallet, with KATSEYE as the western bridge. Every lightstick counts and every bias is defended to the last coin. The favorite to play with ARMYs: warns that the rematch will also be today.

preguntas.q: Do you have to know K-pop to play it?
preguntas.a: No: BTS and lightsticks are recognized by everyone, and the bad items are funny even without context.

preguntas.q: BTS or BLACKPINK?
preguntas.a: BTS usually costs more per fandom, but BLACKPINK performs better per coin in many games.

preguntas.q: What is a nugu group?
preguntas.a: An unknown group without success: at the auction it is punishment with a Korean name.

preguntas.q: Are solos worth more than groups?
preguntas.a: Jungkook, Jimin, j-hope and IU perform very well: the solos are trading higher in this auction.

kpop.tactica: K-pop is pure fandom: detect your opponent's bias in the first round and exploit it mercilessly. Let them pay BTS while you close with Stray Kids, SEVENTEEN and aespa, who perform the same for less. Fake entry and playback are perfect inflators: every fan fears them. And go after IU, TXT and ITZY: items that BTS-only fans are unaware of and leave at merchandising prices.

pokemon_legendarios.descripcion: Mewtwo, Rayquaza, Lugia, Ho-Oh, Dialga, Mew, Kyogre, Palkia, Giratina, Reshiram and Zekrom with Articuno, Zapdos, Moltres, Celebi, Jirachi, Victini and Shaymin completing the pantheon, against Keldeo the forgotten and Phione the almost legendary. The theme of true singularities: there are no imitations here, only legendaries ordered from most to least loved. Each bid is a schoolyard debate raised to coins: is the favorite of your generation worth more or the one with the best statistics? With two legendary birds per generation and only one winner per game, nostalgia is on the rise.

preguntas.q: Why is Phione worth so little?
preguntas.a: Because it is the eternal debate: it is not even clear that he is legendary, and in the auction he pays for that doubt.

preguntas.q: Mewtwo or Rayquaza?
preguntas.a: Mewtwo is more expensive because it is the original, but Rayquaza performs better per coin in most games.

preguntas.q: Is Keldeo really legendary?
preguntas.a: Technically yes, but no one remembers it: that's why it's the perfect punishment for the theme.

preguntas.q: Are Kanto birds worth it?
preguntas.a: Articuno, Zapdos and Moltres are average values that come cheap due to diffuse nostalgia.

pokemon_legendarios.tactica: The legendaries are generations: let the rival pay for their childhood (Mewtwo for those from Kanto, Rayquaza for those from Hoenn) and close with Lugia, Ho-Oh, Dialga and Giratina. Keldeo and Phione are luxury inflators: the debate over their status bids itself. And go after Celebi, Jirachi and Victini: small mythicals that almost no one fights and that decide games in silence.

sandwich.descripcion: Mixed, club, serranito, pepito, croque-monsieur and BLT against the chopped, the cheap mortadella, the sardines and the English cucumber sandwich. The theme of the real sandwich: vegetable, tuna, york and cheese, turkey, submarine, calamari sandwich, ciabatta and bagel in the noble area, and butter and tramezzino where it hurts. No vending machine nonsense: just sandwiches ordered from worst to best, with the well-made sandwich as the undisputed king. It is the quickest theme to explain in the catalog and a death trap for those who despise average items.

preguntas.q: What is the best sandwich?
preguntas.a: The well-done mixed one is usually the most contested, with the club and the mountain range very close.

preguntas.q: What is the serranito?
preguntas.a: The Andalusian sandwich with loin, ham and pepper: a good item that many rivals are unaware of and leave cheap.

preguntas.q: What is the worst sandwich?
preguntas.a: The cucumber English and the butter vie for the red lantern, with the sardines lurking.

preguntas.q: Are the middle items worth it here?
preguntas.a: More than in any theme: the BLT, the vegetable and the tuna close winning teams at a bargain price.

sandwich.tactica: The sandwich deceives because of its simplicity: since all the items seem similar, rivals bid without criteria and the one who does have it wins. Study the menu before starting: mixed, club and serranito are the elite; BLT, vegetable and pepito, the cheap vein. Chopped and cheap bologna are your official inflators: eat them with fake hunger. And never complete the fourth item early: with so much medium level, closing a team early is giving away the good rounds.

helado.descripcion: Stracciatella, pistachio, mango, vanilla, chocolate, lemon, nougat, cream, strawberry, mint and coffee against the melted, the coneless, the strange flavor, the sand, the ice and the stick. The most summery theme in the catalog: coconut, banana and watermelon for the classics, with coffee ice cream and coconut ice cream as tapas that almost no one fights against. It is best played in heat, like ice cream, and is the favorite for terrace games with children around. Few items, quick decisions and comebacks to the sun: the meltdown stalks those who trust.

preguntas.q: What is the most popular flavor?
preguntas.a: The stracciatella usually leads, with the pistachio and mango right behind.

preguntas.q: Is nougat a good item?
preguntas.a: Better than it looks: it is a seasonal medium-high value that usually comes cheap out of mental season.

preguntas.q: What is the worst thing that can happen to you?
preguntas.a: The stick alone, the ice and the sand: the podium of freezing desolation.

preguntas.q: Is it suitable for playing with children?
preguntas.a: Perfect: familiar flavors, five-minute games and punishments that make you laugh instead of fear.

helado.tactica: The ice cream melts and so do the games: everything happens so quickly that the rival bids on impulse. Be the adult at the ice cream shop: pass up the stracciatella if it gets expensive and close with pistachio, mango and vanilla, which almost always come at a fair price. Melt and weird flavor are ideal puffers because no one wants them but everyone pretends they could bite. And save your coins for last: the nougat and the cream usually fall late and decide more games than it seems.

podcasts.descripcion: Nadie Sabe Nada, La Ruina, ROCA Project, The Wild Project, Criminopatía, El Partidazo, El Larguero, La Fórmula del Éxito, Tengo un Plan, Loop Infinito, La Escóbula and Dossier Negro against the eternal talk show, the 40-minute ad, the guest who never shows, the lost episode and the mid-show ad. The theme of what plays on every phone: here you bid on shows, not songs, with La Cotorrisa, SPICY4TUNA and Tómate un Vino in the after-dinner zone. It is the most "on the go" theme in the catalog: each item is a different companion for the commute, and arguing about which one deserves your ears is half the game.

preguntas.q: What is the most bid-on podcast?
preguntas.a: Nadie Sabe Nada usually leads, with La Ruina very close in the decisions.

preguntas.q: Are there sports podcasts?
preguntas.a: Yes: El Partidazo and El Larguero represent classic sports radio reinvented.

preguntas.q: What's the worst that can happen?
preguntas.a: The eternal talk show and the 40-minute ad: punishments every listener painfully recognizes.

preguntas.q: Are true crime ones worth a lot?
preguntas.a: Criminopatía and Dossier Negro are medium-high values that almost no one fights hard enough for.

podcasts.tactica: Podcasts are played on habit: each player overvalues what they listen to every day, so let the rival pay a premium for their favorite show while you close with Criminopatía, La Escóbula and Tengo un Plan. The eternal talk show and the 40-minute ad are universal inflators: every listener hates them and almost everyone bites. And go after ROCA Project and Loop Infinito, shows that comedy-only listeners don't know and leave cheap.

matcha.descripcion: Uji, latte, harvest, bowl, foam, iced, oatmeal, cup, kit, snack, wagashi, ice cream, autumn and bubbles against the substitute, the open bottle, the lumps, the water, the fork and the bitter face. The theme of the green boom: Japanese ceremony with Uji tea and wagashi versus powders of dubious origin and jars that have been open for months. It is the most Zen theme in the catalog and also the most treacherous, because almost no one knows what they are really bidding on: ignorance equalizes the two players and turns each round into an act of faith with a bamboo whisk.

preguntas.q: Why is there a shortage of matcha?
preguntas.a: Because demand has skyrocketed and the plantations cannot cope: at auction, what is scarce is worth gold.

preguntas.q: What is Uji?
preguntas.a: The Japanese region of the highest quality tea: its matcha is the most coveted item in the theme.

preguntas.q: What are wagashi?
preguntas.a: The traditional sweets that accompany the tea ceremony: an average item that almost no one fights for and comes out cheap.

preguntas.q: Do I need to understand tea to play it?
preguntas.a: No, and that's the fun of it: since no one knows much, the person who bids the best wins, not the person who knows the most.

matcha.tactica: Matcha is green fog: no one knows the items, so pure psychology wins the game. The Uji and the latte are the beacons: if the rival names them with certainty, pretend to know more and force him to pay for the lesson. Lumps, substitutes and open bottles are perfect inflators because they sound bad even to those who don't understand. And attack the forgotten means (wagashi, cup, kit): the entire ceremony is bought cheap while others fight over the green powder.

raperos.descripcion: Canserbero, Kase.O, Nach and Residente against Foyone and ToteKing, with Mala Rodríguez, SFDK, Natos and Waor, Violadores del Verso, Orishas, Vico C, Tego Calderón, Ana Tijoux, Control Machete, Akapellah, Lil Supa, Alcolirykoz, La Etnnia and El Chojin in the middle. The theme of studio MCs: lyrics rule here, not improvisation, and every bid sparks a debate about who has the best album. Important notice: battle rappers (Aczino, Trueno, Chuty) have their own theme in Freestylers; only studio rappers are included here. The favorite theme to play with someone while rap plays in the background.

preguntas.q: Do battle rappers like Aczino or Trueno appear?
preguntas.a: No: battle rappers have their own theme in Freestylers; only studio rappers are included here.

preguntas.q: Who is the most valuable?
preguntas.a: Canserbero usually leads unanimously, with Kase.O and Nach completing the podium.

preguntas.q: Is there Latin American rap?
preguntas.a: A lot: Residente, Orishas, Vico C, Tego, Ana Tijoux and Control Machete represent the other side of the pond.

preguntas.q: What is the worst thing about the microphone?
preguntas.a: Foyone and ToteKing: punishments that not even the most hardcore rappers defend in public.

raperos.tactica: Studio rap is played by discographies: let the rival pay Canserbero at a legendary price while you close with Nach, Residente and Mala Rodríguez, who perform the same for less. Foyone and ToteKing are perfect inflators: no one wants them but everyone has an opinion. And go after Ana Tijoux, Orishas and Control Machete: many don't know Latin rap and it comes at a bargain price in Spanish games.

freestylers.descripcion: Chuty, Gazir, Aczino, Wos, Skone, Blon, Walls, Mecha, Larrix, El Menor, Nitro, Letra, Teorema, Marithea and Sara Socas with Arkano as master of ceremonies, against Tirpa, Force, Sweet Pain and Bnet. The theme of freestyle battles: pure improvised wit, with nothing written, where a minute can be worth a career. Every bid is a round: whoever hesitates loses, and whoever overpays for their favorite battler is left without a reply for the rest of the battle. With Red Bull and the FMS in the background, it is the loudest theme in the catalog.

preguntas.q: Who is the GOAT of freestyle?
preguntas.a: The eternal debate is Chuty against Aczino, and this auction is not going to resolve it.

preguntas.q: How is it different from Rappers?
preguntas.a: Here only improvisation battlers compete; studio MCs have their own theme in Rappers.

preguntas.q: Do women compete here?
preguntas.a: Yes: Marithea and Sara Socas are solid values that many underestimate due to lack of knowledge.

preguntas.q: Is Bnet as bad as they say?
preguntas.a: In the auction, yes: it is the best-known punishment in the theme, perfect for inflating the price.

freestylers.tactica: Freestyle is about the reply: let the rival pay for their battler (almost always Chuty or Gazir) and build your team with Skone, Blon, Mecha and Larrix, who improvise just as well for less. Tirpa, Force and Bnet are golden inflators: other people's wit bids on its own. And go after Marithea, Sara Socas and Teorema: battlers that Spain-only fans don't know and who come out at a first-round price.

futbol.descripcion: Messi, Cristiano, Lamine Yamal, Maradona, Pelé, Zidane, Iniesta, Xavi, Ronaldinho, Rodri, Pedri, Casillas and Nico Williams in the same auction, with Harry Maguire, Antony, Karius, Lord Bendtner, Madrid's Hazard, Gravesen and Dembélé as punishment. It is the queen theme for those who discuss soccer on a daily basis: each item has its context, its era and its legend, and the game becomes a covert debate about who was better. With the Ballon d'Or at stake in every round, it's impossible not to defend your idol to the last coin.

preguntas.q: Does Lamine Yamal appear in the soccer theme?
preguntas.a: Yes, it is one of the most recent and most sought-after items, along with Messi and Cristiano.

preguntas.q: Messi or Cristiano?
preguntas.a: The debate that divides games: Messi is almost always more expensive, but Cristiano performs better per coin in many cases.

preguntas.q: Who is Lord Bendtner?
preguntas.a: The Danish striker turned into a meme for his self-confidence: at the auction he is punished with a noble title.

preguntas.q: Are defenders worth anything?
preguntas.a: Maldini is not here, but Casillas and Iniesta are: those who only look at forwards leave them cheap.

futbol.tactica: Soccer rewards those who know times: legends (Messi, Cristiano, Maradona) decide games, but everyone wants them and they come out expensive. The profitable move is to let the rival bleed for his idol while you close the team with solid internationals at half the price. And be careful with punishments with funny names: bidding for Bendtner by bluffing only works once per rival.

nba.descripcion: Michael Jordan, LeBron James, Kobe Bryant, Stephen Curry, Magic Johnson, Larry Bird, Shaquille O'Neal, Tim Duncan, Giannis, Jokic, Durant and Kareem dominate an auction that also includes Allen Iverson and the legendary busts: Kwame Brown, Anthony Bennett, Darko Milicic, Adam Morrison, Olowokandi and Jan Vesely. The favorite theme of those who get up early to watch games and those who only know the documentaries, with Brian Scalabrine as a cult hero. Every ring counts and every failed draft hurts: bidding here is playing general manager with coins.

preguntas.q: Who is the most valuable item in the NBA?
preguntas.a: Michael Jordan is usually the most contested, with LeBron and Kobe right behind.

preguntas.q: Jordan or LeBron?
preguntas.a: Jordan is more expensive per myth, but LeBron performs better per coin in most games.

preguntas.q: Who was Anthony Bennett?
preguntas.a: The number 1 of the 2013 draft that did not work: in the auction it is the punishment with the most pedigree.

preguntas.q: Are Europeans worth it?
preguntas.a: Giannis, Jokic and Nowitzki-adjacentes perform very well: the solo-NBA-classic ones leave them cheap.

nba.tactica: The NBA is salary management: let the rival pay the GOAT tax for Jordan or LeBron and build your quintet with Curry, Duncan, Giannis and Jokic, who decide the same for less. The busts (Bennett, Kwame, Darko) are perfect inflators: draft failures bid themselves. And go after Scalabrine and Iverson: cult items that come cheap and close teams with character.

tenis.descripcion: Rafa Nadal, Federer, Djokovic and Serena Williams in the same auction: the Big Three and the best player in history. Bad items include Bernard Tomic and Karsten Braasch, remembered for losing to the Williams sisters smoking between points.

preguntas.q: Is it the most equal theme in the catalog?
preguntas.a: Yes, it distributes its values in a very balanced way, so the games are decided by strategy rather than luck.

boxeo.descripcion: Muhammad Ali, Mike Tyson, Mayweather and Pacquiao head the auction, with Charlie Zelenoff as the bad guy. It is a theme of stories: each name brings a fight, an era and a controversy, and that is noticeable in the bids.

preguntas.q: Who is Charlie Zelenoff?
preguntas.a: A boxer known for his challenges recorded on the internet more than for his victories; in the auction it is one of the worst items.

esports.descripcion: Faker, s1mple, ZywOo and G2 Esports with the contrast of TSM and Renegades. The theme for those who follow League of Legends and Counter-Strike, and a window to the competitive world for those who have only heard of Faker.

preguntas.q: Who is Faker?
preguntas.a: The most recognized player in League of Legends and the most bid on item in the eSports theme.

coches.descripcion: Ferrari F40, Porsche 911, Supra turbo and McLaren F1 in front of a Seat Panda and a Yugo, with a pit stop: Bugatti Chiron, Aston Martin DB5, neon lights and gold wheels. The theme of those who hang posters of cars since they were children, with items that are the history of the motor and others that are the history of shame.

preguntas.q: Why is there a Seat Panda?
preguntas.a: As a tribute to the quintessential Spanish car: it is a bad item with a lot of love, and it always brings a smile to your face.

mundial_2026.descripcion: Spain champions, Argentina, England and France with Morocco and Belgium on the prowl, against Haiti, Uzbekistan and the Czech Republic. The theme of the 20 teams of the 2026 World Cup: Spain and Argentina always emerge as finalists, and the rest is history of the summer of 2026.

preguntas.q: Do Spain and Argentina always go out?
preguntas.a: Yes, they are the finalists and the non-negotiable basis of the theme, just like cheese and tomato on pizza.

mundial_2026.tactica: With Spain and Argentina fixed in all games, the World Cup is played in the second tier: England, France, Morocco and Belgium decide who wins. Don't go blind with your favorite selection if it comes out expensive; the real semi-finalists are better bought when the rival has already spent on their flag. And remember that only 8 of the 20 come out in each game: each duel tastes different and there is always plan B.

padel.descripcion: Coello, Tapia, Triay, Brea and Galán with Salazar, Josemaría and the lethal viper, against the ball off the glass and the broken racket. The theme of the sport played in every neighborhood: here you bid for the number ones and the fence makes you suffer.

preguntas.q: Who are the number ones in padel?
preguntas.a: Coello and Tapia in men's, Triay and Brea in women's: they dominate the Premier Padel circuit and the auction.

f1.descripcion: Ayrton Senna, Michael Schumacher, Fernando Alonso and Lewis Hamilton on a legendary grid, with Luca Badoer and Yuji Ide as a reminder that not all F1 drivers were fast. The favorite theme of those who watch the races at dawn.

preguntas.q: Who is the most valuable driver of the theme?
preguntas.a: Senna and Schumacher tend to be the highest bidders, with Alonso and Hamilton in the same group.

videojuegos.descripcion: Elden Ring, GTA V, Zelda: Breath of the Wild and Red Dead Redemption 2 versus Big Rigs and Sonic 2006. The theme to discuss masterpieces and disasters, and to discover which of the two players remembers the releases most fondly.

preguntas.q: Are there any famous bad games coming out?
preguntas.a: Yes: Big Rigs and Sonic 2006 are legends of the disaster and in the auction they function as punishment.

juegos_mesa.descripcion: Catan, Gloomhaven, Carcassonne and chess against Monopoly and Parcheesi. It is the most ironic theme in the catalog: the games that everyone has at home are precisely the ones that score the worst, while the niche ones fight for a fair bid.

preguntas.q: Why is Monopoly a bad item?
preguntas.a: Because it is the game that we have all played and almost no one wants to repeat: at the auction it is the perfect punishment.

consolas.descripcion: PlayStation 2, Game Boy, Super Nintendo and Switch in the same auction, with Ouya and Nokia N-Gage as historical failures. The theme that awakens living room memories: each console brings back an entire generation of memories.

preguntas.q: What is the most valuable console?
preguntas.a: The PS2 usually leads the bids, with the Game Boy and Super Nintendo close behind.

moviles.descripcion: Nokia 3310, iPhone 4, Motorola RAZR and BlackBerry versus Amazon Fire Phone and YotaPhone. It is the most nostalgic theme for those who lived through the shift from brick phones to smartphones, and a history lesson for younger players.

preguntas.q: Why is the Nokia 3310 so popular?
preguntas.a: Because of its reputation for being indestructible and for being the first phone of an entire generation; it is the most bid-on item in the theme.

juguetes.descripcion: LEGO, Tamagotchi, Funko limited edition and action figure against the Pet Rock and the squishy with slime. The theme of collecting: here you do not bid on what is worth the most, but on what reminds you most of the Three Wise Men in your house.

preguntas.q: What is the most valuable toy?
preguntas.a: LEGO is usually the most contested, ahead of the Tamagotchi and the limited edition Funko.

gta_vi.descripcion: Leonida, Jason, the perfect heist and a convertible against the WASTED, the traffic jam on the bridge and the municipal tow truck. The theme of the biggest launch in video game history, two months before it comes out: pure hype in the form of an auction.

preguntas.q: Do you need to have played GTA to enjoy it?
preguntas.a: No: Vice City, the robberies and WASTED are recognizable to anyone, and the bad items are funny without context.

zombies.descripcion: Samurai katana, chainsaw and underground bunker in front of a garbage container and the T virus. It is the only theme where the items are not people but survival equipment, and that completely changes the auction strategy.

preguntas.q: What is the T virus?
preguntas.a: The one that started it all: at the auction it is the origin of the apocalypse and a big ticket item.

piratas.descripcion: Blackbeard, Jack Sparrow, Francis Drake and Henry Morgan with the contrast of the woundless patch and the plastic parrot. The quintessential adventure theme, with items ranging from historical privateer to carnival costume.

preguntas.q: Does Jack Sparrow appear?
preguntas.a: Yes, and it is usually one of the most bid-on items, along with Blackbeard.

vikingos.descripcion: Ragnar Lodbrok, Thor, Odin and Loki against a leaky longship and a short oar. The theme mixes history and mythology: the Norse gods attract bidding almost as much as the heroes of the series, and the bad items are as laughable as the good ones are scary. Works great with someone who only knows Vikings from the movies.

preguntas.q: Are there gods or just historical Vikings?
preguntas.a: There is everything: Ragnar and Odin coexist in the same auction, which makes it more fun.
